title: SpecMan Project Manifest
description: Canonical JSON Schema for a specman.json project manifest file.

$schema.description: A relative file URL pointing to this schema.

name.description: The project name. Any UTF-8 string; free-form and human-readable.

description.description: A human-readable description of the project.

tags.description: Tags for categorization. Must not be null.

alias.description: A local name for the referenced artifact. Used in local path resolution and symlink naming. Should be stable across versions of the referencing project.

url.description: The git remote URL. Must be an SSH git link (git@gitservice.com:owner/repo.git) or an HTTPS git link (https://gitservice.com/owner/repo.git). Must be usable as an argument to git clone.

ref.description: A reference to a specific commit. Either a full 40-character SHA-1 commit hash or a git tag name. Branches are never consulted.

index.description: The workspace-relative path to the main Markdown document for this specification. The file must exist at the specified path. This is the only document scanned for constraint groups.

references.description: A list of dependencies on other specifications. May be absent or an empty array, but must not be null.

implements.description: The specifications this implementation targets. Must contain at least one entry.

utilizes.description: Other implementations this implementation depends on. May be absent or an empty array, but must not be null.

ref.description: The specification being implemented. The referenced artifact must be a specification.

constraints.description: A list of regex patterns. Matched against full dot-delimited constraint group identifiers (e.g., concept-slug.category). If absent or empty, functionally equivalent to ['.*'] (all constraint groups are included). Must not be null.

ref.description: The implementation being utilized. The referenced artifact must be an implementation.

ignore_constraints.description: A list of regex patterns. Constraint groups from the utilized implementation that match any of these patterns are filtered out and ignored during compliance evaluation. May be absent or an empty array, but must not be null.
